structure_path.title: PDB 结构路径
structure_path.description: Path to a complex PDB file (needs atom names, so it cannot come from a PdbReader table form).

binder_chains.title: 设计链
binder_chains.description: Binder chains to redesign, e.g. 'A' or 'AH'. All other chains are held fixed.

target_chains.title: 固定链
target_chains.description: Chains to keep fixed. Empty uses every chain not listed as binder.

proteinmpnn_path.title: ProteinMPNN 仓库路径
proteinmpnn_path.description: Checkout containing protein_mpnn_run.py. Empty falls back to OPERON_PROTEINMPNN_PATH.

design_ranges.title: 设计区间
design_ranges.description: Restrict binder design to these residues, e.g. A:26-33,A:50-65 (VHH CDRs). Empty designs the whole binder chain.

fixed_positions.title: 额外固定位置
fixed_positions.description: Extra positions to keep fixed, e.g. A:1-20,B:5. Target chains are always fixed.

bias_aa.title: 氨基酸偏好
bias_aa.description: Per-amino-acid logit bias, e.g. 'C:-1.0,W:0.5' lowers cysteine and raises tryptophan.

omit_aa.title: 禁用氨基酸
omit_aa.description: Residues never sampled, e.g. 'C' to avoid free cysteines.

sampling_temp.title: 采样温度
sampling_temp.description: ProteinMPNN accepts one temperature or a space separated list.

seed.title: 随机种子
seed.description: The official runner treats 0 as 'pick a random seed', so the default is 1.

python_executable.title: Python 解释器
python_executable.description: Interpreter used for protein_mpnn_run.py. Empty uses the current interpreter.
